affected_party: QIF adopters using different Agent Skill clients
actual_problem: QIF distributes a structurally valid Skill but cannot yet record whether independent clients discover it and reproduce its observable quality behavior.
why_it_matters: A portable folder can still fail through client-specific routing, ignored instructions, or unobservable evidence gaps.
why_now: v0.8.12 ships the Skill and v0.8.13 closes policy learning, leaving behavioral portability as the named frontier.
